captured_cases.expected_outcome: The real round-5 atom D run, copied byte for byte after the canonical module gained approver, loads at stage promotion.
An introduced flag on a field the module already carries is still refused at start by name.
The real round-5 atom E request declaring rollout.widening_month as introduced starts, and promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the leaf.
The real structured-KPI request without any introduced flag still starts exactly as before.

atomic_step.outcome: A started atom run whose introduced contract field has since landed in the canonical module keeps loading and promotes; the 'introduced field already resolves' refusal applies only when a new run starts.
atomic_step.practical_value: CM-B13 (2026-09-05): round-5 atom D started through the Atom 16 door, its experiment was recorded, the canonical module gained the approver field, and every command that loaded the run refused it — atoms D, E and F cannot reach promotion.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The real D run loads at stage promotion through the corrected controller; a new start declaring an existing field as introduced is still refused; the real E request with an introduced rollout leaf still starts and is still gated at promotion; the round-4 request still starts.

composition.assembly_contract: A started atom run whose introduced contract field has since landed in the canonical module keeps loading and promotes; the 'introduced field already resolves' refusal applies only when a new run star

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any metric fails on any case, or the promoted controller refuses the real request.
final_validation.operator_path: Run the candidate controller's real start against the real United Partners repository for every frozen request and its promotion-time validation for the introduced field; promoted validation then starts the real round-5 request through the installed controller.
final_validation.success_criterion: The real D run loads at stage promotion through the corrected controller; a new start declaring an existing field as introduced is still refused; the real E request with an introduced rollout leaf still starts and is still gated at promotion; the round-4 request still starts.

approaches.hypothesis: Declaring an existing field as introduced is wrong only when a new run starts; a started run whose field landed must load and promote.
approaches.implementation: the two 'already resolves' refusals in _resolve_contract_field fire only at stage start
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: none for the author; a resumed run with a stale introduced flag is accepted, as it should be

approaches.hypothesis: Dropping the refusal at every stage is enough.
approaches.implementation: neither 'already resolves' refusal fires at any stage
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: an author can mark an existing field as introduced at start and hide that the atom changes nothing
